<!-- Search open AND closed issues/PRs first. Update a matching report with useful
new evidence instead of posting duplicates or repeated pings. Agents need the
end user's authorization to publish; installation permission alone is not enough.
See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/agent-runbook.md. -->

## Expected and observed behavior

Describe the difference and user impact/severity.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal synthetic steps, affected project version/full commit SHA, and
relevant OS/build/architecture, browser/runtime version, viewport or display scale.
State reproducibility and attempted fixes. Link matching issues/PRs or say what
search terms you checked, including closed reports.

## Evidence and acceptance

Include a few inspected sanitized error/code lines and how the fix will be
verified. Replace private paths with `<checkout>` or `<data>`. Do not attach raw
logs, exports/data folders, reminder contents, configured city/coordinates, device
names, screenshots, capture tokens, credentials, or browser profiles. Use the
runbook evidence allowlist. Keep sensitive security details out of public issues;
use an authorized private security channel if available.

Link a fixing PR when ready. One issue per root cause; no unsolicited @mentions,
agent summoning, or repeated progress comments.
